name: Mindfulness & Flow
description: On-horse mindfulness exercise to help rider and horse stay present and reduce mental noise.
instructions: Place your horse and yourself in a safe, low-demand context (halt or easy walk) before starting this tool.

Follow this focus: Take a deep breath and center yourself. Stay with rhythm. Notice what's working. Keep it easy. 5-senses sweep; savor 3 smooth strides. Soft contact, steady cadence; reward the sigh lick chew..  End with a calm breath, a soft hand, and note one small win before moving on.
Continue for the suggested duration or several breaths/strides, then return to normal riding and briefly notice what feels different.
evidence_base: Mindfulness-based stress reduction (MBSR), attentional control training, and equine-assisted mental skills work.
